purpose: Test whether temporal positional representation causally contributes to the post-retention residual observed in Question B.

intervention.off_diagonal_columns: borrow temporal positions from the corresponding target condition for the same semantic identities

primary_bridge_metric.name: directional projection fraction
primary_bridge_metric.definition: For directed source->target: flatten action chunks; delta_B = target-row identity output - source-row identity output; delta_T = source-row target-temporal output - source-row identity output; projection_fraction = dot(delta_T, delta_B) / dot(delta_B, delta_B).

interpretation.positive: temporal intervention moves the source output in the direction of the target matched-history output
interpretation.negative: temporal intervention moves away from the target output

secondary_metrics: MAE source identity vs source temporal-swapped output
MAE source temporal-swapped output vs target-row identity output
distance reduction toward target-row identity output
cosine alignment between temporal-intervention delta and Question-B residual delta

interpretation_rules.positive_consistent_projection: supports direct causal contribution of temporal positional representation to the Question B matched residual
interpretation_rules.mixed_or_zero_projection: temporal position affects outputs but does not by itself explain the direction of the Question B residual

hard_stop: Any retained-identity, temporal-map, replay, cache, shape, or model-boundary invariant failure aborts the run.

process_handling.role: P1/P2/P3 are technical nuisance repeats, not scientific N
process_handling.procedure: compute each directed bridge metric separately within P1, P2, and P3, then average the three values for each episode x directed comparison before cohort-level analysis
